numericModel.half: One adjacent FP16 ULP covers either nearest or directed/truncating conversion. Normal spacing = 2^(floor(log2(abs(x)))-10); subnormal spacing = 2^-24.
numericModel.moment: deltaW + 2*abs(sx)*deltaX + deltaX^2 + 2*abs(sz)*deltaZ + deltaZ^2, plus gamma32(3) for the original dot product.
numericModel.mip: Ideal double-precision average of original stored base texels. A 2x2 hardware reduction may round intermediate lerps at the source FP16 precision: pair(A,B) has E=(EA+EB)/2 + gamma32(2)*average(abs(center)+E) + ULP16(upperMagnitude); apply the pair operation twice, taking the larger row-first/column-first interval. A separately authored cancellation fixture checks this model.
numericModel.mipScope: The black-box mip generator is not assumed to use CPU-style FP32 summation. The source-format intermediate-precision model is conservative and checked independently; fitting that bound does not identify the vendor internal arithmetic or prove that it literally uses FP16 ALUs.
numericModel.bilinear: Local partial derivatives times bounded weight error, including the cross term, plus at most one FP16 ULP at each of two lerp stages and FP32 arithmetic/coordinate error. Values across +/-epsilon are not required to be identical.
numericModel.weightError: One 8-fractional-bit ULP (1/256), rather than a fitted absolute signal tolerance; independently checked with a known ramp fixture.
numericModel.scope: The NVIDIA guide documents its texture-unit 8-bit fractional weights. Applying this bound to the current WebGL driver is a hardware-path inference guarded by calibration, not a universal WebGL precision guarantee.
numericModel.correction: THREE r180 DataUtils.toHalfFloat shifts away mantissa bits (truncation); it is not a round-to-nearest-even oracle for GPU mip generation. No DataUtils half conversion is used in this check.

limits: This is a 256-mode directional Fourier synthesis check, not an FFT, nonlinear wave solver, SWE validation or visual realism assessment.
CPU oracle uses the original double-precision mode constants; tolerances allow half-float storage, float shader arithmetic and mip quantization.
Base-level finite/sign scans cover every texel. Fourier comparisons use a deterministic subset including corners and boundary texels.
The 30000-second test uses a temporary instance of the same factory on the same renderer. The active instance time, phase buffers, textures and update counter are never changed.
A successful periodic/mip check does not prove the absence of all temporal aliasing, visible repetition or camera-dependent shimmer.
The mip oracle checks a 2x2 box-reduction model with propagated FP16 bounds. A different legal driver reduction kernel would need its own oracle, rather than silently widening these bounds.
Readback and CPU execution durations are not GPU timings or scene FPS. This check allocates temporary offscreen targets and briefly blocks the main JS thread.
